zh: 原创潮玩角色，一只炭黑、带陶土短绒质感的短圆身，右肩长出一条扁铜烤叉作为它的右臂：拿掉这条叉就没有角色。头是略扁的短圆，几乎没有颈，左臂短钝，腹下两枚短钝足。铜叉前伸，长度约等于身宽的一点二倍，叉尖圆钝，微微上翘，绝不尖锐。平视略睁的小黑豆眼，极小一字嘴，表情淡，不笑不怒。身体微微被叉带着前倾，双足仍站在原地。主体是炭黑陶绒，只有那条叉是圆钝的亮铜，腹前有一小块暖米。配色是炭黑配亮铜，加一点暖米。单个角色完整全身，正面略侧，站在浅灰纯色背景前，柔和棚拍光，像真实的搪胶毛绒或手办产品照。不要儿童绘本或涂色书风格，不要卡通吉祥物，不要闪亮的动漫大眼，不要穿衣服的人类小孩造型，不要奔跑、跳跃或任何动作场景，不要速度线，不要细长的橡皮管式手脚，不要细长的手指，不要张嘴大笑，不要多余的饰品和细节，不要背景物件。不要真人脸发型服装，不要明星姓名，不要现有潮玩或品牌名，不要疾病、伤口或残缺造型，不要整体透明果冻身体。不要尖锐叉尖，不要穿刺，不要手握工具，不要烧烤场景，不要食物堆，不要争抢表情，不要奖杯。
enp: Original designer toy character: a charcoal ceramic-plush short rounded body whose right arm is a flat copper skewer growing from the shoulder — without the skewer there is no character. Slightly flattened round head, almost no neck, a short blunt left arm, two short blunt feet. The copper skewer reaches forward about 1.2 times the body width; the tip is rounded and slightly upturned, never sharp. Slightly open tiny black bean eyes look level, a tiny straight mouth, expression calm, not smiling or angry. The body leans a little with the skewer, feet still planted. Body is charcoal ceramic-plush; only the skewer is blunt bright copper, with a small warm-ivory patch on the belly. Colors: charcoal with bright copper and a warm-ivory accent. Single character, full body, slight three-quarter front view, standing on a plain light grey background, soft studio lighting, looks like a real vinyl-plush or figure product photo. No children's book or coloring page style, no cartoon mascot, no big shiny anime eyes, no clothed human child figure, no running, jumping or action scene, no speed lines, no thin rubber-hose limbs, no thin long fingers, no wide open-mouth grin, no extra accessories or details, no background props. No real person's face, hairstyle or clothing, no celebrity names, no existing toy or brand names, no disease, wounds or disfigurement, no fully transparent jelly body. No sharp tines, no piercing, no handheld tool, no barbecue scene, no piles of food, no competitive expression, no trophy.
